notes.title: XIIZEAL V1.05 : Fix for replay scores overwriting local scores
notes.content:
The latest version for XIIZEAL is out and it fixes the following things:
[list]
    [*]Fix for replay scores downloaded from the leaderboard etc that would overwrite player's local score.
    [*]Fix to prevent monitor powering off while game is active.
    [*]Enabled window to be resized by dragging the edge of it.
    [*]Added boot_log.txt to the folder containing the game's executable to save log data.
    [*]Added the ability to change the sensitivity of the left stick on Direct Input controllers by editing win_state.ini (details below).
    [*]Fixed leaderboard functionality whereby pressing X to show player position would not function properly.
[/list]

[b]Settings File win_state.ini[/b]
By editing this file, located with the game executable, you can change game settings.
If the file is not saved or cannot be loaded, settings are reverted to default.
File format must be Unicode + BOM.
Left stick sensitivity for USB controllers can be adjusted as follows: controller_threshold	0.5f	; [0.0f - 1.0f]

Thanks for playing XIIZEAL and keep on waggling!

notes.title: XIIZEAL V1.04 Leaderboard Fixes
notes.content:
[b]XIIZEAL V1.04 Patch Details - 07/07/2015[/b]

This patch update fixes minor bugs in the leaderboards.

[list][*]Fixed an error where replay icons weren't shown past rank 20 on the leaderboards.
[*]XIIZEAL now displays a "Connecting now" message while retrieving leaderboard data.
[*]Fixed an error that would show an empty leaderboard instead of the "No Entry" notification.[/list]

リーダーボードのマイナー修正 

[list][*]リーダーボード閲覧時20位より大きい順位にリプレイがアタッチされているのにその情報が表示されていなかったのを修正。
[*]リーダーボード閲覧時ページ送りの際"CONNECTING NOW..."と表示するよう修正。
[*]リーダーボード閲覧時エントリーの無いリーダーボードが表示されていたのを修正。[/list]
